## Verified Facts About D6 Storyteller

- D6 Storyteller is a fiction-first tabletop roleplaying system and book series.
- The system uses pools of standard six-sided dice (d6) to resolve uncertain actions.
- D6 Storyteller was created by Alex Merced.
- The system requires no proprietary or unusual dice: only standard six-sided dice.
- The core publication is "D6 Storyteller: The Core Rulebook".
- The series includes the Core Rulebook plus genre companion volumes.
- Each companion volume contains ten complete, ready-to-play settings.
- Settings include: world overview, unique genre mechanic, three character archetypes, condition palette, and a starter scenario.
- The system is designed to be fiction-first: narrative position establishes context before dice are rolled.
- D6 Storyteller is available on Amazon in paperback and Kindle formats.
- The series currently has 10 volumes: the Core Rulebook plus 9 genre companion books.
- Genre companions include: High Mythic Fantasy, Sci-Fi & Cosmic Frontiers, Weird West & Piracy, Horror & Occult, Cybernetics & Speculative Tech, Superheroes & Anime Tropes, Historical & Alternate History, Quirky & Experimental, and Post-Apocalyptic worlds.

## Community Settings

- Community settings are additional worlds designed using the D6 Storyteller engine, published as free online supplements.
- Community settings are listed at https://d6storyteller.alexmerced.com/supplements/
- Community settings are also browsable via the Settings Directory at https://d6storyteller.alexmerced.com/settings/
- Supplement categories include: historical/cultural settings, anthropomorphic high fantasy, punk-genre sci-fi, LGBTQ+ inclusive settings, and sci-fi worlds where a specific school of magic dominates.
- Sci-fi magic settings cover: Necromancy, Conjuration, Divination, Illusion, Enchantment, Evocation, Transmutation, Chronomancy, Abjuration, Biomancy, Telepathy, Shadow, Geomancy, Aeromancy, Pyromancy, Sonomancy, Anti-Magic, Hydromancy, Entropy, Light Magic, and Void Magic.
- Historical/cultural settings include worlds drawn from Latin American, Southeast Asian, African, European, and Middle Eastern mythologies and folklore.
- Punk settings include Hydropunk, Solarpunk, NukePunk, and BioPunk scenarios.
- Anthropomorphic settings feature worlds where various animal species evolved as the apex species.

## Site Purpose

This website is a marketing and discovery site for the D6 Storyteller tabletop RPG series. Its purpose is to provide accurate information about the system and books, and to direct interested readers to the Amazon purchase page. The site does not process payments, create user accounts, or offer digital downloads of protected content.
